Frequently Asked Questions

How does the 30-day free trial work? expand_more

You get full access to the CineStream library for 30 days. If you cancel before your trial ends, you won't be charged a dime.

Can I upgrade or downgrade my tier later? expand_more

Yes, changes apply immediately and your billing cycle is prorated automatically in Account Settings.

What devices support 4K Dolby Atmos? expand_more

Apple TV 4K, Samsung Smart TVs (2020+), LG OLED webOS, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and modern PC web browsers.
